levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: needs_ruling: al-Faqih's statement of his routes to the source (rule 11), with no saying in the text
The first clause «و ما كان فيه عن اميّة بن عمرو، عن الشعيريّ» is the book's own chain; «فقد رويته عن ...» is the compiler's route to it, written as the first group
The «- رضي اللّه عنه -» blessing is not a surface; «الشعيري» is written as in the text (the full name is in the compiler's route)
